description: Finding all my models or profile elsewhere than Civitai is without my consent ! Please don't repost my files. Send people to my Civitai profile, thanks :) - "Home of The Ancients" is a new serie to thank all my followers. It's a Special Edition serie. -- 01 - Thieves Den The dataset has 80+ pics to make various scenes. Various environments : Streets Tavern Guild A lone thief Sewers Fortress Graveyard Some environments have multiple scenes in them. Some have their own trigger word. Of course you can mix these environments together. -- HOW TO USE : Strength : 1 tested Steps : 15 tested Checkpoints : Any but I mostly used the Base Fp8 and Base BF16 models. Adetailer : not used, your choice Sampler : Tested with EULER Scheduler : NORMAL -- No main trigger words but... Some scenes have their own trigger word : Streets : STR02 to STR06 Streets : STR01N for night, STR01D for day (same for STR07D & STR07N) Taverns : TAV01, TAV02 Fortress : FOTR01, FOTR02 Guild : GUL01 Graveyards : GRAV01, GRAV02 Other scenes don't use any trigger words :) -- see pictures for prompt exemples :) -- Have fun ^^
